dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit, WHO-HAEM5 HGBL-DH category), germinal-center B-cell type, with diffuse large B-cell morphology.

mn_dx_dlbcl_nos.quote: the 2026-09-12 report read DLBCL NOS and was amended 2026-09-19 after FISH

dx_gcb_hans.quote: GCB phenotype by Hans (CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1/IRF4-).

tx_plan_outdated.quote: Do not give R-CHOP. Cancel the R-CHOP cycle 1 order (held for 2026-09-22) and rebuild as DA-EPOCH-R

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage II, bulky, A (no B symptoms). Two nodal regions on the same side of the diaphragm: right cervical levels II-IV (largest 3.9 cm on PET) and anterior mediastinum (12.0 x 8.6 x 9.8 cm

mn_stage_iii_iv.quote: Stage would change to IV only if marrow is involved.

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: Double-expressor by IHC: MYC 80% (cutoff 40%), BCL2 90% strong (cutoff 50%).

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: IPI is 1 (LDH only; age 54, ECOG 1, stage II, fewer than 2 extranodal sites) and R-IPI is good, but these scores under-call him because they do not capture double-hit biology, which drives early relapse across IPI strata.

tx_intensive_curative.quote: Do not give R-CHOP. Cancel the R-CHOP cycle 1 order (held for 2026-09-22) and rebuild as DA-EPOCH-R (listed as a preferred regimen for HGBL with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangements), 21-day cycles for 6 cycles

mn_rchop_preferred.quote: Do not give R-CHOP. Cancel the R-CHOP cycle 1 order (held for 2026-09-22)

mn_non_curative.quote: Fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54; ECOG 1 at the 9/8 visit

tx_isrt_consolidation.quote: Consolidative involved-site RT only for residual bulky mediastinal PET-positive disease after chemotherapy.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: CNS-IPI was not designed for double-hit disease, and MYC plus BCL2 rearrangement with raised LDH and bulky disease place him in the group where CNS prophylaxis is reasonable

cns_prophylaxis.quote: CNS prophylaxis: IT methotrexate 12 mg on day 1 of each cycle if CSF is negative (see cns_risk).

mn_cns_dismissed.quote: Treat as elevated risk for CNS relapse. Formal CNS-IPI is low: 1 point (LDH above ULN)

resp_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT after cycle 6 (Lugano): Deauville 1-3 is a complete metabolic response; residual mediastinal uptake at 4-5 warrants consolidative involved-site RT or observation per tumor board.

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis each cycle (pegfilgrastim or on-body injector, from day 6 or 7).

sup_tls.quote: TLS: high risk (bulk, LDH 3.3 to 3.6 times ULN, uric acid 7.9 and rising). Start IV hydration and allopurinol 300 mg daily 1-2 days before chemotherapy; if G6PD is normal and uric acid stays above about 8 mg/dL or rises, give single-dose rasburicase on day 1 instead.

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: cycles 2-6 can be ambulatory with a 96-hour pump.

sup_fertility.quote: Fertility: offer sperm banking before the first dose and document the discussion.

sup_svc_airway.quote: written escalation plan for stridor, progressive facial or arm swelling, or orthopnea (urgent dexamethasone and urgent radiation oncology review for low-dose palliative RT before chemotherapy).

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis: HBsAg non-reactive, anti-HBc non-reactive, anti-HBs reactive (vaccine-immune), so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF 60% and GLS -20% (2026-09-11) are adequate for doxorubicin; baseline ECG; no repeat echo unless symptoms.

fit_intensive.quote: Fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54; ECOG 1 at the 9/8 visit (tires by mid-afternoon, working half-days by 9/14); eGFR 101, bilirubin 0.6, AST and ALT normal (9/4); LVEF 60%
